releasebot: Emergency hotfix request: v2.3.1-quickpatch -> us-west2 due to embed tail p95 spike at 15:10 UTC causing client timeouts. Proposing expedited staged rollout with telemetry gates and auto-fallback to v2.3.0.

alex: what's in the patch? any data model changes?

jit: only changes KV cache TTL and scheduler fairness. No schema changes. Smoke-tested in staging.

oncall-ops: we're inside short freeze (ends in ~20m). Ops allows emergency patch with SRE+Product signoff. I can run traffic shifts.

alex: rollback criteria: p95 > baseline +30% sustained 2m OR error-rate +0.5% absolute. Manual rollback available.

releasebot: run dry-run: `/deploy dry-run release=v2.3.1-quickpatch region=us-west2 canary=5%`

deploybot: DRY-RUN OK: release v2.3.1-quickpatch, region us-west2, canary 5%, steps validate->deploy->telemetry

oncall-ops: prefer 10m canary. Need explicit +1 reactions in thread to proceed.

alex: +1

jit: :thumbsup:

oncall-ops: :thumbsup:

releasebot: approvals received. Starting canary: `/deploy release=v2.3.1-quickpatch region=us-west2 canary=5% wait=600 monitor=true fallback=v2.3.0`
